plt.plot(x, y, marker="o")
plt.xlabel("X")
plt.ylabel("Y")
plt.show()

references.title: pandas.DataFrame.groupby
references.summary: Official pandas reference for grouping rows and calculating aggregates.
references.syntax:
result = df.groupby("category", as_index=False).agg(
    total=("value", "sum"),
    mean_value=("value", "mean"),
    count=("value", "count")
)

references.title: Dash app
references.summary: Official Dash documentation for Python web apps.
references.import:
from dash import Dash, html, dcc
import plotly.express as px
references.syntax:
app = Dash(__name__)
app.layout = html.Div([
    html.H1("Dashboard"),
    dcc.Graph(figure=px.scatter(df, x="x", y="y"))
])
app.run(debug=True)
